title: Are Tokyo's 5 Most Viral Instagram Restaurants Actually Good? We Checked Japanese Tabelog Reviews!
description:
You've seen these 5 viral Tokyo dishes all over Instagram and TikTok—from the 300g 'Unclosed' Katsudon to the Jewel-Box Kaisendon and Charcoal Hamburger Steaks on fresh kettle rice. But are they actually good, or overpriced tourist traps? We checked their real scores on Japanese Tabelog (tabelog.com) and translated real Japanese customer reviews—including the secret branch hacks that save you ¥1,700 and 90 minutes in line!

segments.subtitle:
You've seen these 5 viral Tokyo dishes all over Instagram.
We checked Japanese Tabelog reviews to see if they're actually worth it!
segments.narration: You have definitely seen these five viral Tokyo dishes all over Instagram—the overflowing unclosed pork cutlet bowl, the jewel-box seafood mountain, and the sizzling charcoal hamburger steaks on fresh kettle rice. But what do Japanese locals actually say about them? We checked Japan's strictest restaurant site, Tabelog, and translated real Japanese customer reviews to rank all five from number five to number one—plus the insider hacks you need before you go.

segments.place_ja: 第5位：とんかつ 丸七（食べログ ★3.51｜極厚・閉じない焼きカツ丼）
segments.insider_tip: VIRAL DISH: 'Yaki-Katsudon' places crispy 300g pork ON TOP of fluffy eggs so it stays crunchy!
segments.subtitle:
#5: Tonkatsu Marushichi (Tabelog ★3.51).
Famous on Instagram for its 300g 'Unclosed' Katsudon that overflows the lid.
segments.narration: Starting at number five with a strong three point five one on Tabelog is Tonkatsu Marushichi, the shop that sparked Japan's viral unclosed katsudon craze. Instead of simmering the breaded pork in broth and making the crust soggy, Marushichi lays a massive, golden-fried domestic pork cutlet directly on top of a blanket of soft-scrambled eggs and sweet ginger tare sauce.

segments.place_en: What Japanese Reviewers Say About Tonkatsu Marushichi
segments.place_ja: とんかつ丸七：食べログのリアルな日本語口コミ＆注意点
segments.budget: Go to Main Shop or Ikebukuro
segments.insider_tip: ALERT FROM JAPANESE REVIEWS: The Fukagawa Fudo annex closed—visit Monzen-Nakacho Main Shop or Ikebukuro!
segments.review_praise_ja: 「お肉が本当にあっさり柔らか！卵で閉じて汁がいっぱいなのが苦手な私にピッタリのサクサク感」（食べログ口コミ）
segments.review_praise_en: "The sous-vide pork is shockingly tender and light! Keeping the cutlet unclosed preserves the crunch."
segments.review_warn_ja: 「上（300g）は超ボリューミーなので初回は並（150g・1,700円）が堅実。深川不動店は閉店したので門前仲町本店か池袋店へ！」
segments.review_warn_en: "300g is huge—first-timers should order Nami (150g, ¥1,700). Note: Fukagawa annex closed; visit Monzen-Nakacho Main or Ikebukuro!"
segments.subtitle:
Real Japanese Reviews: 'Shockingly tender pork & crispy crust!'
Tip: Order the 150g Nami (¥1,700) at the Monzen-Nakacho Main Shop.
segments.narration: What do real Japanese Tabelog reviewers say? Locals praise how surprisingly light and tender the low-temperature cooked pork is, and love that the breading stays crunchy until the last bite. However, Japanese reviewers warn that the three-hundred-gram size is overwhelming for first-timers—so order the one-hundred-fifty-gram Nami for seventeen hundred yen, and make sure you visit the Monzen-Nakacho main shop or Ikebukuro branch, as the old Fukagawa annex recently closed.

segments.place_en: Nihonbashi Tsujihan — Jewel-Box Kaisendon & Sea Bream Broth
segments.place_ja: 第4位：日本橋海鮮丼 つじ半 日本橋本店（食べログ ★3.59）
segments.insider_tip: VIRAL DISH: 'Zeitaku-don' (Luxury Mountain of 9 Seafoods) that transforms into hot Sea Bream Chazuke!
segments.subtitle:
#4: Nihonbashi Tsujihan (Tabelog ★3.59).
A glistening mountain of tuna, ikura, shrimp, and sea urchin for just ¥1,350.
segments.narration: At number four, scoring three point five nine on Tabelog, is Nihonbashi Tsujihan, just four minutes from Tokyo Station. Its only menu item is the Zeitaku-don—a glittering mountain of minced tuna, salmon roe, sweet shrimp, conch, and sea urchin served over warm sesame rice, starting at just thirteen hundred fifty yen for the Ume size.

segments.place_en: What Japanese Reviewers Say About Nihonbashi Tsujihan
segments.place_ja: 日本橋 つじ半：食べログのリアルな日本語口コミ＆鯛だし茶漬けの法則
segments.insider_tip: LOCAL RULE: Save 2 slices of sesame sashimi on your side plate to drop into the hot Sea Bream Dashi!
segments.review_praise_ja: 「平日11時半でも1時間半待ち！でも最後の熱々の鯛出汁茶漬けが最高すぎて、待つ価値が絶対にある美味しさ」（食べログ口コミ）
segments.review_praise_en: "Even with a 90-minute weekday wait, the rich hot Sea Bream Dashi Chazuke finale makes every minute worth it!"
segments.review_warn_ja: 「別皿のゴマだれのお刺身を2枚残しておいて、最後に鯛出汁を入れてもらうのが鉄則！並びたくない人はテイクアウトかアークヒルズ店へ」
segments.review_warn_en: "Save 2 slices of sesame sashimi for the hot sea bream broth at the end! To skip the 90-min line, visit the Ark Hills branch."
segments.subtitle:
Real Japanese Reviews: 'The hot sea bream broth finale makes the wait worth it!'
Hack: Save 2 sashimi slices for the broth, or visit the Ark Hills branch.
segments.narration: Japanese reviewers on Tabelog admit the Nihonbashi main shop regularly has a sixty to ninety minute wait even on weekdays. Yet almost every reviewer says the second half of the meal makes the wait worth it: when you have a third of your rice left, hand your bowl to the chef, who pours in piping-hot sea bream broth. Follow the Japanese rule—save two slices of the sesame-marinated sashimi from your starter plate to poach inside that hot broth!

segments.place_en: Ginza Kagari — Creamy Truffle Tori-Paitan Soup Ramen
segments.place_ja: 第3位：銀座 篝（かがり）本店（食べログ ★3.66・百名店）
segments.insider_tip: VIRAL DISH: Rich, velvety chicken paitan potage broth topped with seasonal veggies and black truffle!
segments.subtitle:
#3: Ginza Kagari (Tabelog ★3.66).
Famous on Instagram for its golden, potage-like creamy chicken paitan ramen.
segments.narration: Number three is Ginza Kagari, rated three point six six on Tabelog. Tucked down a Ginza back alley, Kagari became an Instagram phenomenon for its Tori-Paitan Soba—a broth made by boiling whole domestic chickens until the soup turns as rich and velvety as French potage, topped with colorful seasonal vegetables and fragrant truffle.

segments.place_en: Shocking Truth in Japanese Reviews About Ginza Kagari!
segments.place_ja: 銀座 篝：食べログの日本人口コミが暴く「本店3,000円 vs 大手町店1,300円」の真実
segments.area: SECRET HACK: Go to Otemachi Branch!
segments.insider_tip: BIGGEST INSIDER HACK: Skip Ginza Main Shop (¥3,000 tourist price) and go to Kagari Otemachi (¥1,300, no line)!
segments.review_praise_ja: 「濃厚でクリーミーな鶏白湯スープと季節の野菜、卓上の黒七味や有機玄米酢での味変が本当に絶品！」（食べログ口コミ）
segments.review_praise_en: "The velvety chicken paitan soup and flavor changes with black seven-spice and brown rice vinegar are phenomenal!"
segments.review_warn_ja: 「銀座本店は外国人行列な上にトリュフ鶏白湯が3,000円に高騰！オフィス街の『大手町店』なら鶏白湯sobaが1,300円で待ち時間もほぼなし！」
segments.review_warn_en: "Ginza Main Shop hiked its truffle bowl to ¥3,000 for tourists! Go to the Otemachi branch—same creamy bowl for ¥1,300 with zero wait!"
segments.subtitle:
Japanese Tabelog Secret: Ginza Main Shop charges ¥3,000 with huge tourist lines.
Locals go to Kagari's Otemachi branch for the ¥1,300 bowl with zero wait!
segments.narration: Here is where reading Japanese Tabelog reviews saves your wallet. Japanese reviewers love the creamy soup, but they point out a shocking truth: the Ginza main shop is packed with tourists and now charges up to three thousand yen for its truffle bowl! Instead, Tokyo office workers go to Ginza Kagari's Otemachi Station branch—where you get the exact same creamy Tori-Paitan Soba for just thirteen hundred yen with almost zero wait!

segments.place_en: Udon Shin Shinjuku — Freshly Cut Glossy Udon & Giant Tempura
segments.place_ja: 第2位：うどん 慎（食べログ ★3.68・うどん百名店｜新宿）
segments.insider_tip: VIRAL DISH: Translucent, freshly boiled noodles twisted in a bowl with sky-high burdock or shrimp tempura!
segments.subtitle:
#2: Udon Shin in Shinjuku (Tabelog ★3.68, Hyakumeiten).
Every single portion is cut, weighed, and boiled fresh to order—never pre-cooked.
segments.narration: Taking number two with an elite three point six eight score and multiple Tabelog Top One Hundred awards is Udon Shin in Shinjuku. Why does it dominate both Instagram and Japanese Tabelog? Because the chef refuses to pre-boil a single noodle. Every order is freshly rolled, cut, and boiled on the spot, creating translucent, silky noodles with an unforgettable chewy snap.

segments.place_en: What Japanese Reviewers Say About Udon Shin Shinjuku
segments.place_ja: うどん 慎：食べログのリアルな日本語口コミ＆おすすめの頼み方
segments.budget: Fast Turnover After Ordering in Line
segments.insider_tip: MUST-ORDER FROM REVIEWS: 'Goboten' (Crispy Burdock Tempura) OR Hot Butter-Pepper-Bacon 'Carbonara' Udon!
segments.review_praise_ja: 「艶のある美しい麺を口に入れた瞬間の喉越しが最高！今まで食べたうどんで一番美味しい。カルボナーラ風の釜たま＋ベーコン天ぷらも激うま」
segments.review_praise_en: "The silky throat-feel of these glossy noodles is unmatched—easily the best udon of my life! The butter-bacon kamatama is incredible."
segments.review_warn_ja: 「金曜14時20分着で待ち25分。並んでいる間にメニューを渡されて事前注文する形式なので、着席してからは10分で提供されて回転が早い！」
segments.review_warn_en: "Arrived at 2:20 PM and waited just 25 minutes. Staff take your order while you're in line, so your bowl arrives 10 minutes after sitting!"
segments.subtitle:
Real Japanese Reviews: 'The glossy noodles have an unmatched silky snap!'
Tip: Go around 2:30 PM—staff take your order in line so food arrives fast.
segments.narration: In Japanese Tabelog reviews, locals rave that the silky throat-feel of the cold zaru udon and the rich butter-pepper-bacon kamatama udon are the best they have ever tasted. Reviewers also share a great timing tip: visit around two-thirty P M on a weekday. The wait drops to about twenty-five minutes, and because staff take your order while you are outside, your freshly boiled udon arrives just ten minutes after you sit down.

segments.place_en: Hikiniku to Come Shibuya — 3 Charcoal Hamburgs & Kettle Rice
segments.place_ja: 第1位：挽肉と米 渋谷（食べログ ★3.70｜炭火焼ハンバーグ×羽釜炊き立てご飯）
segments.insider_tip: VIRAL CONCEPT: Three 90g freshly ground 100% beef patties grilled over charcoal and served ONE BY ONE!
segments.subtitle:
#1: Hikiniku to Come Shibuya (Tabelog ★3.70).
Tokyo's #1 viral sensation that even strict Japanese Tabelog critics rate 3.70!
segments.narration: And at number one, scoring a massive three point seven zero on Tabelog, is Hikiniku to Come in Shibuya. Their motto is simple: freshly ground, freshly charcoal-grilled, and freshly cooked rice. You sit around a dramatic stadium counter where chefs grill ninety-gram one-hundred-percent beef patties over live charcoal and place them onto your personal wire rack one by one—so every single bite is piping hot and bursting with meat juice.

segments.place_en: What Japanese Reviewers Say About Hikiniku to Come
segments.place_ja: 挽肉と米 渋谷：食べログのリアルな日本語口コミ＆3個の黄金ルーティン
segments.budget: Free Rice Refills + 1 Free Raw Egg
segments.insider_tip: THE 3-BURGER RULE: #1 Plain on rice -> #2 With grated daikon & homemade condiments -> #3 With raw egg TKG!
segments.review_praise_ja: 「炭火で焼かれたハンバーグは肉汁がジューシーそのもの！毎月銘柄が変わる羽釜ご飯がおかわり自由で、6種の薬味での味変がアミューズメント！」
segments.review_praise_en: "The charcoal-grilled patties burst with juice! Unlimited refills of monthly single-origin Hagama kettle rice and 6 condiments make it pure entertainment."
segments.review_warn_ja: 「渋谷店は完全WEB記帳（オンライン予約）制で終日満席！ただし当日の朝にサイトを覗くとキャンセル空き枠が拾えることがあるので要チェック！」
segments.review_warn_en: "Shibuya is 100% online reservation-only and books out fast—but check the booking page in the morning for same-day cancellation slots!"
segments.subtitle:
Real Japanese Reviews: '1st burger plain, 2nd with condiments, 3rd with raw egg!'
Booking Hack: Check the online reservation page in the morning for open slots.
segments.narration: Japanese reviewers call this the ultimate nineteen-hundred-eighty-yen food entertainment. Follow the local three-burger ritual: eat the first patty plain over the freshly steamed kettle rice, eat the second with grated daikon and six house-made condiments like青唐辛子 salt-lemon, and finish the third burger over a free raw egg yolk on a fresh rice refill! Remember, the Shibuya shop is one hundred percent online reservation only—check the booking site in the morning to snag same-day slots.
